name: Blinded
description: You cannot see and automatically fail ability checks requiring sight. Attacks against you have Advantage, and your attacks have Disadvantage.

name: Charmed
description: You cannot attack the charmer or target them with damaging abilities or magical effects. The charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact with you socially.

name: Deafened
description: You cannot hear and automatically fail ability checks requiring hearing.

name: Exhaustion
description: Exhaustion is cumulative. Each level imposes a -2 penalty on your D20 Tests and reduces your Speed by 5 feet. You die at level 6. Finishing a Long Rest removes one level; the condition ends at level 0.

name: Frightened
description: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the source of fear is within line of sight, and you cannot willingly move closer to it.

name: Grappled
description: Your Speed is 0 and cannot increase. Your attacks against targets other than the grappler have Disadvantage. The grappler can move you, but each foot costs an extra foot of movement unless you are Tiny or at least two sizes smaller than the grappler.

name: Incapacitated
description: You cannot take actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions; you cannot maintain Concentration or speak. If you have this condition when rolling Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.

name: Invisible
description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. Effects requiring a visible target cannot affect you unless their creator can see you; your worn and carried equipment is also concealed. Attacks against you have Disadvantage and your attacks have Advantage, except against a creature that can see you.

name: Paralyzed
description: You are Incapacitated and your Speed is 0. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against you have Advantage; a hit is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

name: Petrified
description: You and your nonmagical worn and carried objects become solid inanimate material. Your weight is multiplied by ten and you stop aging. You are Incapacitated, your Speed is 0, attacks against you have Advantage, and you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves. You have Resistance to all damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

name: Poisoned
description: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
description: You can crawl or spend movement equal to half your Speed to stand and end this condition; you cannot stand if your Speed is 0. Your attacks have Disadvantage. Attacks against you have Advantage from within 5 feet and Disadvantage from farther away.

name: Restrained
description: Your Speed is 0 and cannot increase. Attacks against you have Advantage, your attacks have Disadvantage, and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

name: Stunned
description: You are Incapacitated, automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves, and attacks against you have Advantage.

name: Unconscious
description: You are Incapacitated and Prone, drop what you are holding, and are unaware of your surroundings. Your Speed is 0, attacks against you have Advantage, and you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves. A hit is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet. You remain Prone after this condition ends.
